story.title: A Journey of Forest Rebirth
story.p1: Dai Ngan Xanh was born from the aspiration to reforest barren hills with Aquilaria crassna – the thousand-year treasure of the Central Highlands.
story.p2: Every tree you plant is not only a value-generating asset, but also a green lung protecting mother earth and upstream water sources.

product.title: Native Aquilaria – Natural Agarwood
product.desc: Native Aquilaria crassna thrives in the fertile basalt soil of Dak Lak, offering profound ecological, spiritual, and economic value.
product.card1Desc: Every tree is assigned a unique identifier, precise GPS coordinates, and monitored through on-site field cameras.
product.card2Desc: Committed to 1-for-1 replacement planting free of charge over 5 years against climate perils or pest damage.
product.card3Desc: Enjoy full agarwood yields and carbon credit benefits at harvest time through completely transparent accounting.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Do I own the tree after payment?
faq.a1: Yes. You receive a digital certificate and unique GPS identifier with legal ownership under our partnership agreement.
faq.q2: What happens if a tree dies or suffers natural hazards?
faq.a2: We maintain a 100% replacement insurance policy: our forestry team will replant a new tree at no extra cost.
faq.q3: How can I monitor my tree?
faq.a3: Log in to your CRM 'My Garden' dashboard to view satellite map coordinates, periodic photo updates, and care logs.

why.title: Why Now?
why.desc: Vietnam’s forests are shrinking, storms are fiercer, catastrophic floods and extreme weather are the whispers Mother Nature uses to warn us. Aquilaria - a resilient native tree with year-round green leaves, silently purifies the air and restores a fresh atmosphere.
why.quote: “You don’t need to leave the bustling city to get covered in mud. Right here, with just a touch, you can become part of the Great Forest.”

benefits.title:
More Than Just a Tree,

benefits.b1Desc: The Aquilaria tree is nurtured, breathing and growing silently in the Binh Phuoc Highlands, carrying the love and gratitude you dedicate to Mother Nature.

benefits.b3Desc: Watch your tree grow day by day via "My Garden". Real photos and video updates every quarter.
benefits.b4Desc: Peace of mind knowing that somewhere, a life is thriving thanks to your love.

faqSection.title: Sincere Answers
faqSection.q1: Are the trees real? Can I visit?
faqSection.a1: As real as your breath. We welcome you to visit the garden anytime to touch the textured bark and inhale the delicate natural agarwood scent as the tree matures.
faqSection.q2: What happens if a tree dies?
faqSection.a2: Unforeseen events can occur. However, we commit that barring natural disasters or epidemics, over 10 years, for every 1 tree you plant, 1 mature tree will thrive.
faqSection.a3: 410,000 VND is an all-inclusive cost: seedling, land lease, and 10 years of professional care. This is a transparent fee with zero hidden costs throughout your journey.
